help:
opencode stats [command]

Commands:
  opencode stats dashboard              show a balanced usage dashboard               [aliases: dash, overview, summary]
  opencode stats breakdown [dimension]  attribute cost, tokens, and requests by one dimension              [aliases: by]
  opencode stats timeline               inspect daily volume, composition, health, and active days      [aliases: daily]
  opencode stats sessions               rank individual sessions by tokens, cost, calls, or recency   [aliases: session]
  opencode stats insights               show quantitative usage shape, attribution, outliers, and actions
                                                                                                      [aliases: insight]

Options:
      --help         Show help                                                                                 [boolean]
      --version      Show version number                                                                       [boolean]
      --days         show stats for the last N days (0 means today)                               [number] [default: 60]
      --all-time     include all recorded usage instead of the default 60 days                [boolean] [default: false]
      --project      filter by project (default: all projects, empty string: current project)                   [string]
      --color        ANSI color mode                     [string] [choices: "auto", "always", "never"] [default: "auto"]
      --tools        shortcut to tool breakdown; optionally pass number of tools
      --models       shortcut to model breakdown; pass a number for top N
  -n, --limit        number of rows to show                                                                     [number]
  -i, --interactive  cycle stats views with keyboard shortcuts                                [boolean] [default: false]
